description: Read-only, non-blocking check of exactly which state a claim_trial_inbox connection is in RIGHT NOW: "claim_pending", "claimed" (credential issued, unused), or "client_installed" (a client has actually authenticated with it at least once -- real, observed). Never returns a credential. Use this instead of await_trial_inbox_claim when you want to check progress WITHOUT blocking, especially much later than the original chat session -- installing a client into its own config is a human action with no fixed timeline, so polling this occasionally (not in a tight loop) is the right way to check back. Each response includes a next_action field telling you exactly what to say or do.

claim_token.description: The token from claim_trial_inbox's claim_url (the part after /claim/).

name: claim_connection_status
